sources: https://reserveohio.com/OhioCampWeb/#!park/109 (ReserveOhio API ohiordr.usedirect.com: search/place for PlaceId 109, search/grid for its three facilities, search/details for all 154 web-listed units on 2027-06-15, plus sites 001 and 016 on 2027-06-19 and 2027-01-12, read 2026-10-30)

values.note: Electric sites $35 a night, full hookups $46, the same on a Saturday (June 2027). Off-peak (January 2027) both are $31. Plus tax and a $6.50 reservation fee per reservation. ReserveOhio's prices read 2026-10-30.

fees.source: ReserveOhio search/details for all Barkcamp units, 2027-06-15 (Campsite Electric 35.00, Campsite Full Hookup 46.00, Fee 6.50); site 001 (electric) and 016 (full hookup) on Sat 2027-06-19 (35.00 / 46.00) and 2027-01-12 (31.00 / 31.00), read 2026-10-30

hookups.source: ReserveOhio search/details (Electricity Hookup '50' on every campsite; Water Hookup and Sewer Hookup 'Yes' on the 20 full-hookup sites) + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/barkcamp-state-park-campground ('15 Full Hookup sites'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: ReserveOhio lists 104 RV campsites (84 electric, 20 full hookup), all back-in, mostly asphalt, 30-57 ft (site 106 is 21 ft); besides them 27 equestrian electric sites (35-80 ft) for campers with horses and 15 tent-only sites. ODNR's page says 'Over 120 Electric sites', 15 full hookup, 15 tent only and 25 equestrian. Pets on designated sites.

sites.source: ReserveOhio search/details (UnitType, PullInTypeName 'Back In', Maximum Camping Unit Length per site) + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/barkcamp-state-park-campground ('Over 120 Electric sites', '15 Full Hookup sites', '15 sites are Tent Only', '25 Equestrian sites have electric and accommodate campers with horses', 'Pet camping is permitted on designated sites'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Showerhouse; mini golf, playground, basketball courts and a nature center in the campground; horse wash at the equestrian sites. Off-peak the showerhouse and dump station stay open, with water at the office and shower house.

facilities.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/barkcamp-state-park-campground ('Barkcamp's cozy campground offers a dump station, mini golf course and playground', 'Off-Peak Season: From Nov. 1 to Apr. 1, the showerhouse and dump stations are available. Water is at the office building and shower house.') + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/barkcamp-state-park ('Camp Store and Park Office have equipment', 'Basketball courts in the campground', 'Nature Center (in the Antique Barn, in the campground)'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Off-peak November 1 to April 1: B Loop closed; showerhouse and dump station open.

season.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/barkcamp-state-park-campground ('Off-Peak Season: From Nov. 1 to Apr. 1, the showerhouse and dump stations are available ... B Loop Closed.') + ReserveOhio rates for 2027-01-12, read 2026-10-30

values.note: Every listed site is web-bookable with a 14-night maximum on ReserveOhio, or call (866) 644-6727. Check-in 3 p.m., check-out 1 p.m.

booking.source: ReserveOhio search/details (AllowWebBooking true on every unit, MaxStay 14, check-in/out times) + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/barkcamp-state-park ('can be reserved online or by calling (866) 644-6727'), read 2026-10-30

summary: Fees: $35 electric base confirmed; added the full-hookup +$11 ($46) the stored note missed, and the $31 off-peak rate. Added 50-amp electric with water/sewer at 20 full-hookup sites, 104 back-in RV sites to 57 ft, showers/water/dump/camp store, year-round season (B loop closed off-peak), ReserveOhio deep link, 14-night max. Pin is in Belmont Lake (see flag). Not stated for this park: window, minimums (left inherited); flush toilets (the per-site catalog lists 'Pit' restrooms).
flags: Pin is in Belmont Lake, 365 m from the nearest campsite: stored 40.0410,-81.0160. ReserveOhio's per-site coordinates for the 104 electric/full-hookup sites centre on 40.03836,-81.02017 (satellite there shows the campground road and loops south-west of the lake). Suggest moving the pin there.
Phone missing: ODNR gives (740) 484-4064 for the campground and the park office alike.
Stored fees note 'Every RV site has electric: $35 a night' omitted the 20 full-hookup sites at $46; the result adds surcharges.full_hookup 11.
